name: Health Assist
description: App Store & Play Store screenshots for a sleep tracking and smart alarm app. One continuous night sky runs behind all five boards while a drifting moon rises, peaks full over the hypnogram board, and dissolves into a peach dawn, with serif headlines, constellation stat chips, and lavender on navy sleep screens.

elements.name: b1-subline
elements.content: Apple Health to Home Assistant, without a cloud.
